title: ASC 942 — Financial Services—Depository and Lending
summary: Governs loan origination fees, allowance for credit losses, core deposit intangibles, and loan modifications for depository and lending institutions.
description: ASC 942 addresses loan origination fees and costs with yield amortization methods, cross-references to ASC 326 for credit losses, post-ASU 2022-02 loan modification guidance, and core deposit intangibles. Key differences with IFRS for depository and lending institutions are noted.

bannerNotice.title: Divergence from IFRS 9
bannerNotice.body: ASC 942's loan modification and credit loss models differ from IFRS 9's expected credit loss approach. Core deposit intangible treatment and loan origination cost deferral also diverge from IFRS norms.
